title: EUV 光源錫滴控制概念
summary: 以 13.5 nm 雷射電漿（LPP）錫滴光源為對象，從錫離子的 4d–4f 發射帶與 CO₂ 雷射的臨界密度出發，建立從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈，再拆解錫滴產生器、前脈衝與主脈衝、錫滴偵測與雷射導向、劑量統計、氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔，最後以可用度與反射率衰減記錄完成驗收。本課為教學模型，不含任何操作程序。
summaryEn: Taking the 13.5 nm laser-produced-plasma tin-droplet source as the object, the course starts from the 4d–4f emission band of tin ions and the critical density of CO₂ laser light, builds the power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus, then works through the droplet generator, pre-pulse and main pulse, droplet detection and laser steering, dose statistics, hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning, and closes with an availability and reflectance-decay acceptance record. It is a teaching model and contains no operating procedure.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」與「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" and "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。雷射在電漿中只能傳到臨界密度面，10.6 µm 的 CO₂ 雷射臨界密度比 1.06 µm 固態雷射低一百倍，電漿較稀薄、自吸收較少，CE 能達到 5% 以上，而固態雷射通常只有 2% 到 3%。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy. Laser light penetrates a plasma only up to the critical-density surface, and the critical density for 10.6 µm CO₂ light is a hundred times lower than for 1.06 µm solid-state light, so the emitting plasma is more dilute with less self-absorption, giving CE above 5% versus typically 2% to 3% with solid-state drivers. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³；Nd:YAG λ = 1.064 µm 時 n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³，相差約 100 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser

knowledge.textEn: When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy. Laser light penetrates a plasma only up to the critical-density surface, and the critical density for 10.6 µm CO₂ light is a hundred times lower than for 1.06 µm solid-state light, so the emitting plasma is more dilute with less self-absorption, giving CE above 5% versus typically 2% to 3% with solid-state drivers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「EUV 光源錫滴控制概念」的「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: mechanism and system boundary” in “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" is correct?
options: 雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。
錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。
光源功率只取決於雷射功率。
optionsEn: More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output.

When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy.
Source power depends only on the laser power.
quiz.explanation: 錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³；Nd:YAG λ = 1.064 µm 時 n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³，相差約 100 倍。13.5 nm 光子能量 hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100. The 13.5 nm photon energy is hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線；以光譜儀確認發射峰位置與 2% 頻寬內的能量比例，與 Mo/Si 反射帶重疊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³；Nd:YAG λ = 1.064 µm 時 n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³，相差約 100 倍。13.5 nm 光子能量 hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV。
knowledge.textEn: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100. The 13.5 nm photon energy is hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser", which statement holds?
options: 前脈衝只是把錫滴預熱，省略也無妨。
只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。
臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³。
optionsEn: The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted.
If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter.
The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³.
quiz.explanation: 臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³；Nd:YAG λ = 1.064 µm 時 n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³，相差約 100 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線；以光譜儀確認發射峰位置與 2% 頻寬內的能量比例，與 Mo/Si 反射帶重疊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線；以光譜儀確認發射峰位置與 2% 頻寬內的能量比例，與 Mo/Si 反射帶重疊。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser"?
options: 用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。
optionsEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The vessel is under vacuum, so the collector cannot get contaminated.
quiz.explanation: 用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線；以光譜儀確認發射峰位置與 2% 頻寬內的能量比例，與 Mo/Si 反射帶重疊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雷射在電漿中只能傳到臨界密度面，10.6 µm 的 CO₂ 雷射臨界密度比 1.06 µm 固態雷射低一百倍，電漿較稀薄、自吸收較少，CE 能達到 5% 以上，而固態雷射通常只有 2% 到 3%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Laser light penetrates a plasma only up to the critical-density surface, and the critical density for 10.6 µm CO₂ light is a hundred times lower than for 1.06 µm solid-state light, so the emitting plasma is more dilute with less self-absorption, giving CE above 5% versus typically 2% to 3% with solid-state drivers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。
knowledge.textEn: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。
光源功率只取決於雷射功率。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics.
Source power depends only on the laser power.
quiz.explanation: 雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「中間焦點與功率鏈」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Intermediate focus and power chain” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光源輸出以中間焦點（IF）的帶內功率定義，IF 是光源與掃描機照明系統的交接面。功率鏈是乘法：雷射平均功率乘以 CE 得到 2π 立體角內的帶內 EUV，再乘以橢球集光鏡收集的立體角比例、多層膜反射率與氫氣透過率，才得到 IF 功率。每一項都小於 1，所以錫滴尺寸、雷射重複率與集光鏡狀態任何一項退化都會直接反映在晶圓產能上。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「中間焦點與功率鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator. The power chain is multiplicative: laser average power times CE gives in-band EUV into 2π steradians, and that is multiplied by the solid-angle fraction captured by the ellipsoidal collector, the multilayer reflectance and the hydrogen transmission before it becomes IF power. Every factor is below 1, so degradation in droplet size, laser repetition rate or collector condition shows up directly in wafer throughput. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Intermediate focus and power chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% gives 20 mJ per pulse, 1000 W of in-band EUV into 2π; the collector captures 5 sr (5/6.28 = 0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so the product 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43 yields about 430 W at IF, 8.6 mJ per pulse, equivalent to 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ photons.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光源功率只取決於雷射功率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Source power depends only on the laser power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「中間焦點與功率鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Intermediate focus and power chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈
knowledge.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus
knowledge.text: 光源輸出以中間焦點（IF）的帶內功率定義，IF 是光源與掃描機照明系統的交接面。功率鏈是乘法：雷射平均功率乘以 CE 得到 2π 立體角內的帶內 EUV，再乘以橢球集光鏡收集的立體角比例、多層膜反射率與氫氣透過率，才得到 IF 功率。
knowledge.textEn: Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator. The power chain is multiplicative: laser average power times CE gives in-band EUV into 2π steradians, and that is multiplied by the solid-angle fraction captured by the ellipsoidal collector, the multilayer reflectance and the hydrogen transmission before it becomes IF power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光源功率只取決於雷射功率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Source power depends only on the laser power. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus" is correct?
options: 光源功率只取決於雷射功率。

Bigger droplets always produce more EUV.

quiz.explanationEn: Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中間焦點與功率鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Intermediate focus and power chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設雷射 20 kW、50 kHz，每脈衝 0.4 J；CE = 5% 得每脈衝 20 mJ、1000 W 帶內 EUV 進入 2π；集光鏡收集 5 sr（5/6.28 = 0.80）、反射率 0.60、氫氣透過率 0.90，合成 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43，IF 功率 ≈ 430 W，每脈衝 8.6 mJ，相當於 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ 個光子。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% gives 20 mJ per pulse, 1000 W of in-band EUV into 2π; the collector captures 5 sr (5/6.28 = 0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so the product 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43 yields about 430 W at IF, 8.6 mJ per pulse, equivalent to 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ photons. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 IF 處以校正過的 EUV 功率計量帶內功率，同時由雷射功率計、CE 量測與集光鏡反射率記錄逐項計算鏈上每個因子，兩者相差超過 10% 時逐項追查是集光鏡污染、氫氣壓力還是錫滴尺寸偏離。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure in-band power at IF with a calibrated EUV power meter while computing every factor of the chain from the laser power meter, the CE measurement and the collector reflectance record; when the two disagree by more than 10%, trace the discrepancy factor by factor to collector contamination, hydrogen pressure or droplet-size deviation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% gives 20 mJ per pulse, 1000 W of in-band EUV into 2π; the collector captures 5 sr (5/6.28 = 0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so the product 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43 yields about 430 W at IF, 8.6 mJ per pulse, equivalent to 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ photons.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus", which statement holds?
options: 設雷射 20 kW、50 kHz，每脈衝 0.4 J。
錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。
真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。
optionsEn: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse.
A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock.

quiz.explanationEn: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% gives 20 mJ per pulse, 1000 W of in-band EUV into 2π; the collector captures 5 sr (5/6.28 = 0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so the product 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43 yields about 430 W at IF, 8.6 mJ per pulse, equivalent to 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ photons. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「中間焦點與功率鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Intermediate focus and power chain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 IF 處以校正過的 EUV 功率計量帶內功率，同時由雷射功率計、CE 量測與集光鏡反射率記錄逐項計算鏈上每個因子，兩者相差超過 10% 時逐項追查是集光鏡污染、氫氣壓力還是錫滴尺寸偏離。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure in-band power at IF with a calibrated EUV power meter while computing every factor of the chain from the laser power meter, the CE measurement and the collector reflectance record; when the two disagree by more than 10%, trace the discrepancy factor by factor to collector contamination, hydrogen pressure or droplet-size deviation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：集光鏡反射率從 0.60 掉到 0.50 看似只少 10 個百分點，但 IF 功率同比例下降 17%，掃描機必須放慢掃描速度補劑量，整條產線的晶圓產能隨之下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A collector reflectance drop from 0.60 to 0.50 looks like only 10 points, but IF power falls by the same 17% ratio, the scanner must slow its scan to keep dose, and wafer throughput of the whole line falls with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 IF 處以校正過的 EUV 功率計量帶內功率，同時由雷射功率計、CE 量測與集光鏡反射率記錄逐項計算鏈上每個因子，兩者相差超過 10% 時逐項追查是集光鏡污染、氫氣壓力還是錫滴尺寸偏離。
knowledge.textEn: Measure in-band power at IF with a calibrated EUV power meter while computing every factor of the chain from the laser power meter, the CE measurement and the collector reflectance record; when the two disagree by more than 10%, trace the discrepancy factor by factor to collector contamination, hydrogen pressure or droplet-size deviation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在 IF 處以校正過的 EUV 功率計量帶內功率，同時由雷射功率計、CE 量測與集光鏡反射率記錄逐項計算鏈上每個因子，兩者相差超過 10% 時逐項追查是集光鏡污染、氫氣壓力還是錫滴尺寸偏離。
驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure in-band power at IF with a calibrated EUV power meter while computing every factor of the chain from the laser power meter, the CE measurement and the collector reflectance record.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure in-band power at IF with a calibrated EUV power meter while computing every factor of the chain from the laser power meter, the CE measurement and the collector reflectance record; when the two disagree by more than 10%, trace the discrepancy factor by factor to collector contamination, hydrogen pressure or droplet-size deviation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中間焦點與功率鏈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Intermediate focus and power chain” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 集光鏡反射率從 0.60 掉到 0.50 看似只少 10 個百分點，但 IF 功率同比例下降 17%，掃描機必須放慢掃描速度補劑量，整條產線的晶圓產能隨之下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A collector reflectance drop from 0.60 to 0.50 looks like only 10 points, but IF power falls by the same 17% ratio, the scanner must slow its scan to keep dose, and wafer throughput of the whole line falls with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每一項都小於 1，所以錫滴尺寸、雷射重複率與集光鏡狀態任何一項退化都會直接反映在晶圓產能上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every factor is below 1, so degradation in droplet size, laser repetition rate or collector condition shows up directly in wafer throughput.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光源功率只取決於雷射功率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Source power depends only on the laser power." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 集光鏡反射率從 0.60 掉到 0.50 看似只少 10 個百分點，但 IF 功率同比例下降 17%，掃描機必須放慢掃描速度補劑量，整條產線的晶圓產能隨之下降。
knowledge.textEn: A collector reflectance drop from 0.60 to 0.50 looks like only 10 points, but IF power falls by the same 17% ratio, the scanner must slow its scan to keep dose, and wafer throughput of the whole line falls with it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
錫滴做得越大，EUV 輸出一定越多。
集光鏡反射率從 0.60 掉到 0.50 看似只少 10 個百分點，但 IF 功率同比例下降 17%，掃描機必須放慢掃描速度補劑量，整條產線的晶圓產能隨之下降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Bigger droplets always produce more EUV.

quiz.explanationEn: A collector reflectance drop from 0.60 to 0.50 looks like only 10 points, but IF power falls by the same 17% ratio, the scanner must slow its scan to keep dose, and wafer throughput of the whole line falls with it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
